verdict.rationale: A package manager could plausibly offer AI-generated suggestions, for example package recommendations or upgrade insights, so this axis applies. The evidence pack shows no AI-generated insights or suggestion feature. Homebrew's anonymous aggregate analytics and `brew info --json` output are data and telemetry features, not AI insights, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
